title: Leome and Partners hero
description: A window-high centred hero: a big two-line headline split by a 3:2 photo (first line in primary, second in highlight) and small labels spread along the bottom edge. On load an intro panel slides up, the words rise out of masks and the labels lift in; while scrolling the photo slowly zooms and the hero stays pinned under the next sections.
notes: pinned (default): it is sticky, so the sections after it need position relative and a z-index to slide over it (wrap them in a relative z-10 div)
the photo zoom follows the page's scroll from the top (scroll(root)), so it suits a hero at the top of the page
all motion is CSS; off under prefers-reduced-motion
name: leome-and-partners-hero

props.name: titleTop
props.description: the headline's first line, above the photo

props.name: titleBottom

props.description:
The 3:2 photo between the two lines; give it `className="size-full object-cover"` and
`alt=""` (it sits inside the headline). It zooms in slowly as the page scrolls. A
placeholder when empty.

props.name: labels
props.description: small labels spread along the bottom edge (practice areas, services…)
